lines.text: The LORD asks why Milcom has taken Gad, and says He will sound the battle cry against Rabbah.
The LORD says Milcom will go into exile together with his priests and officials.
The faithless daughter trusts in her riches, but the LORD says He will afterward restore the Ammonites from captivity.
The LORD asks if wisdom is gone from Teman and tells the dwellers of Moab to turn and run.
The LORD says Edom will be overthrown like Tyre and Sidon, and no one will dwell there.
